git add src/money.js src/locale.js && git commit -m "Fix floating-point precision in currency conversion to cents

Multiple currency parsing functions were multiplying by 100 without
rounding, causing floating-point precision errors. For example, 39.95 
would become 3995.0000000000005 instead of 3995. Added Math.round() to
parseEuros, cellCents, and decimalCommaToCents to ensure whole cents.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
